title: The Living World Runs on Cells
description: The final showdown! Tie every idea together, rebuild the Cell of Life, and drive Lord Necrosis from the living world.

content.value: You began by discovering cells with Robert Hooke, and you now understand the whole hidden machinery of life. Let's tie it all together for the final battle.

THE BIG PICTURE OF THE CELL
🔬  Discovered by Hooke; seen with a microscope
🧱  Basic structural & functional unit of life
🦠  Unicellular (one) or multicellular (many)
🔲  Membrane · 🟡 Cytoplasm · ⚫ Nucleus
🧬  Nucleus holds chromosomes → genes → DNA
🔋  Mitochondria = powerhouse; 🌿 chloroplasts (plants) make food
🌱  Plant cells: wall + chloroplasts + big vacuole

Every single thing a living organism does — breathing, growing, healing, thinking — happens because of cells doing their jobs. When cells work well, the organism is healthy. This is exactly why keeping cells alive defeats the Decay of Lord Necrosis.
One Last Idea: Cells Come From Cells

Here is a final wonder: new cells are made only when existing cells divide. Every cell in your body came from an earlier cell, tracing all the way back to a single cell. Life truly is an unbroken chain of cells.
The whole chapter in one line: all living things are made of cells, the cell is life's basic unit, and every cell comes from another cell.
Key Takeaway: The cell is the basic unit of all life — every life process happens in cells, and new cells come only from existing cells. Understanding cells is understanding life itself.

quiz.question: New cells are formed by…
quiz.explain: All new cells come from the division of pre-existing cells.
